demo.code:
You: what would a covered call on my 3 TSLA on Base pay this week?
Bankr: Kerne reference quote for TSLAc, signed 19:15 UTC:
  Spot $390.45, strike $420.00 (7.56% above spot)
  Premium 86 bps (0.86%), paid in the stock
  Expires Fri Nov 20, 16:00 UTC
  For 3 TSLAc: about 0.0258 TSLAc ($10.07). Gains above $420 are given up.
  Signature verified against Kerne's signer 0x9653...Db88.
  Reference only: the vault is closed and unaudited. Not an offer, not advice.

You: sell that call for me
Bankr: I can't. Nothing executes from this quote, and the vault is closed.

setup: Install the skill with the button below. No API key, no payment, no wallet permission.
Ask: "what is Kerne quoting for a TSLA covered call?" or "what would a covered call on my 3 TSLA pay?"
The skill checks both signatures against the pinned signer 0x9653Bf177239C979921DC8C0639eD00409F4Db88 before it reports a number.

Read only: it never places a trade. The vault it prices for is unaudited and was closed to deposits when this was written (the skill reports the live status). Tokenized stocks are not available to US persons.
